name: The 384 Lines on the Wheel
description: Human Design cuts each of the 64 gates into six lines of 56'15". This grammar pairs each of those 384 cells, in wheel order, with the Zhouyi's own line statement for the same hexagram and line (Legge, 1882, public domain). No Human Design text.

sections.The pairing: Human Design cuts each gate into six lines of 56'15" and numbers them 1 to 6 in the direction of the zodiac. The Zhouyi has six line statements for each hexagram, numbered 1 to 6 from the bottom. This grammar pairs them by number: line 3 of gate 43 here is the third line statement of hexagram 43. The pairing by number is an assumption we make from how both systems number their lines; it is not a claim about meaning.
sections.Two different texts: The sentence on each card is the Zhouyi's own, in James Legge's English of 1882 (public domain). It is not Human Design's text for that line, and the two do not say the same thing. Human Design's line texts are Ra Uru Hu's writing and are not used here.
sections.How to use it: If you know a Human Design placement such as 43.3 (gate 43, line 3), find the card 'Gate 43, line 3' to read the Zhouyi sentence for that figure and line, and the degrees where it falls. The wheel page shows the same positions.
sections.Words in brackets: Words in (brackets) in the English are Legge's own additions to make the terse Chinese read as English.

sections.The Zhouyi in English: James Legge, The Yi King, Sacred Books of the East vol. 16 (Oxford: Clarendon Press, 1882; 2nd ed. 1899). Public domain: Legge died in 1897. Read it at sacred-texts.com/ich/ or in the scan at archive.org (identifier wg916 for the 1882 edition, sacredbooksofchi12conf for the 1899 edition). The text in this library was cross-checked across three digitisations (see grammars/zhouyi-core).
sections.Positions: From grammars/hd-mandala-wheel: the gate order is the Fu Xi circle, each gate begins at the degree given and is 5°37'30" wide, each line 56'15".
sections.Not used: Human Design's gate names, keynotes and line texts; any Gene Keys text.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject suspending his own affairs, and hurrying away (to help the subject of the fourth line). He will commit no error, but let him consider how far he should contribute of what is his (for the other).

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows parties adding to (the stores of) its subject ten pairs of tortoise shells, and accepting no refusal. There will be great good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 6°41'15" Aquarius to 7°37'30" Aquarius. Line 6 of gate 41, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows its subject giving increase to others without taking from himself. There will be no error. With firm correctness there will be good fortune. There will be advantage in every movement that shall be made. He will find ministers more than can be counted by their clans.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth SIX, divided, shows the advance of honesty and generosity. There will be good fortune, and no error.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, (shows the representative of) the union of men just issuing from his gate. There will be no error.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, (shows its subject) mounted on the city wall; but he does not proceed to make the attack (he contemplates). There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°00' Aquarius to 17°56'15" Aquarius. Line 5 of gate 13, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the fifth NINE, undivided, (the representative of) the union of men first wails and cries out, and then laughs. His great host conquers, and he (and the subject of the second line) meet together.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°56'15" Aquarius to 18°52'30" Aquarius. Line 6 of gate 13, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, (shows the representative of) the union of men in the suburbs. There will be no occasion for repentance.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject (as if he were) bound with the skin of a yellow ox.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows its subject making his changes after some time has passed. Action taken will be fortunate. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 20°45' Aquarius to 21°41'15" Aquarius. Line 3 of gate 49, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows that action taken by its subject will be evil. Though he be firm and correct, his position is perilous. If the change (he contemplates) have been three times fully discussed, he will be believed in.

sections.Place on the wheel: 21°41'15" Aquarius to 22°37'30" Aquarius. Line 4 of gate 49, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows occasion for repentance disappearing (from its subject). Let him be believed in; and though he change (existing) ordinances, there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 22°37'30" Aquarius to 23°33'45" Aquarius. Line 5 of gate 49, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows the great man (producing his changes) as the tiger (does when he) changes (his stripes). Before he divines (and proceeds to action), faith has been reposed in him.

sections.Place on the wheel: 23°33'45" Aquarius to 24°30' Aquarius. Line 6 of gate 49, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth SIX, divided, shows the superior man producing his changes as the leopard (does when he) changes (his spots), while small men change their faces (and show their obedience). To go forward (now) would lead to evil, but there will be good fortune in abiding firm and correct.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows one ready to move with confused steps. But he treads at the same time reverently, and there will be no mistake.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows its subject in his place in yellow. There will be great good fortune.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows its subject in a position like that of the declining sun. Instead of playing on his instrument of earthenware, and singing to it, he utters the groans of an old man of eighty. There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 27°18'45" Aquarius to 28°15' Aquarius. Line 4 of gate 30, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows the manner of its subject's coming. How abrupt it is, as with fire, with death, to be rejected (by all)!

sections.Place on the wheel: 28°15' Aquarius to 29°11'15" Aquarius. Line 5 of gate 30, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows its subject as one with tears flowing in torrents, and groaning in sorrow. There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 29°11'15" Aquarius to 0°07'30" Pisces. Line 6 of gate 30, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows the king employing its subject in his punitive expeditions. Achieving admirable (merit), he breaks (only) the chiefs (of the rebels). Where his prisoners were not their associates, he does not punish. There will be no error.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject meeting with his mate. Though they are both of the same character, there will be no error. Advance will call forth approval.

sections.Place on the wheel: 1°03'45" Pisces to 2°00' Pisces. Line 2 of gate 55, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows its subject surrounded by screens so large and thick that at midday he can see from them the constellation of the Bushel. If he go (and try to enlighten his ruler who is thus emblemed), he will make himself to be viewed with suspicion and dislike. Let him cherish his feeling of sincere devotion that he may thereby move (his ruler's mind), and there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°00' Pisces to 2°56'15" Pisces. Line 3 of gate 55, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows its subject with an (additional) screen of a large and thick banner, through which at midday he can see (the small) Mei star. (In the darkness) he breaks his right arm; but there will be no error.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows its subject in a tent so large and thick that at midday he can see from it the constellation of the Bushel. But he meets with the subject of the (first) line, undivided like himself. There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 3°52'30" Pisces to 4°48'45" Pisces. Line 5 of gate 55, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows its subject bringing around him the men of brilliant ability. There will be occasion for congratulation and praise. There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 4°48'45" Pisces to 5°45' Pisces. Line 6 of gate 55, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows its subject with his house made large, but only serving as a screen to his household. When he looks at his door, it is still, and there is nobody about it. For three years no one is to be seen. There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 5°45' Pisces to 6°41'15" Pisces. Line 1 of gate 37, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject establishing restrictive regulations in his household. Occasion for repentance will disappear.

sections.Place on the wheel: 6°41'15" Pisces to 7°37'30" Pisces. Line 2 of gate 37, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows its subject taking nothing on herself, but in her central place attending to the preparation of the food. Through her firm correctness there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 7°37'30" Pisces to 8°33'45" Pisces. Line 3 of gate 37, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows its subject (treating) the members of the household with stern severity. There will be occasion for repentance, there will be peril, (but) there will (also) be good fortune. If the wife and children were to be smirking and chattering, in the end there would be occasion for regret.

sections.Place on the wheel: 8°33'45" Pisces to 9°30' Pisces. Line 4 of gate 37, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject enriching the family. There will be great good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 9°30' Pisces to 10°26'15" Pisces. Line 5 of gate 37, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows the influence of the king extending to his family. There need be no anxiety; there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 10°26'15" Pisces to 11°22'30" Pisces. Line 6 of gate 37, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows its subject possessed of sincerity and arrayed in majesty. In the end there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 11°22'30" Pisces to 12°18'45" Pisces. Line 1 of gate 63, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, (shows its subject as a driver) who drags back his wheel, (or as a fox) which has wet his tail. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 12°18'45" Pisces to 13°15' Pisces. Line 2 of gate 63, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, (shows its subject as) a wife who has lost her (carriage-)screen. There is no occasion to go in pursuit of it. In seven days she will find it.

sections.Place on the wheel: 13°15' Pisces to 14°11'15" Pisces. Line 3 of gate 63, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, (suggests the case of) Kâo Žung, who attacked the Demon region, but was three years in subduing it. Small men should not be employed (in such enterprises).

sections.Place on the wheel: 14°11'15" Pisces to 15°07'30" Pisces. Line 4 of gate 63, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject with rags provided against any leak (in his boat), and on his guard all day long.

sections.Place on the wheel: 15°07'30" Pisces to 16°03'45" Pisces. Line 5 of gate 63, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows its subject (as) the neighbour in the east who slaughters an ox (for his sacrifice); but this is not equal to the (small) spring sacrifice of the neighbour in the west, whose sincerity receives the blessing.

sections.Place on the wheel: 16°03'45" Pisces to 17°00' Pisces. Line 6 of gate 63, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows its subject with (even) his head immersed. The position is perilous.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows one adorning (the way of) his feet. He can discard a carriage and walk on foot.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°56'15" Pisces to 18°52'30" Pisces. Line 2 of gate 22, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows one adorning his beard.

sections.Place on the wheel: 18°52'30" Pisces to 19°48'45" Pisces. Line 3 of gate 22, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows its subject with the appearance of being adorned and bedewed (with rich favours). But let him ever maintain his firm correctness, and there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 19°48'45" Pisces to 20°45' Pisces. Line 4 of gate 22, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows one looking as if adorned, but only in white. As if (mounted on) a white horse, and furnished with wings, (he seeks union with the subject of the first line), while (the intervening third pursues), not as a robber, but intent on a matrimonial alliance.

sections.Place on the wheel: 20°45' Pisces to 21°41'15" Pisces. Line 5 of gate 22, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows its subject adorned by (the occupants of) the heights and gardens. He bears his roll of silk, small and slight. He may appear stingy; but there will be good fortune in the end.

sections.Place on the wheel: 21°41'15" Pisces to 22°37'30" Pisces. Line 6 of gate 22, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth NINE, undivided, shows one with white as his (only) ornament. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 22°37'30" Pisces to 23°33'45" Pisces. Line 1 of gate 36, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject, (in the condition indicated by) Ming Î, flying, but with drooping wings. When the superior man (is revolving) his going away, he may be for three days without eating. Wherever he goes, the people there may speak (derisively of him).

sections.Place on the wheel: 23°33'45" Pisces to 24°30' Pisces. Line 2 of gate 36, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows its subject, (in the condition indicated by) Ming Î, wounded in the left thigh. He saves himself by the strength of a (swift) horse; and is fortunate.

sections.Place on the wheel: 24°30' Pisces to 25°26'15" Pisces. Line 3 of gate 36, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows its subject, (in the condition indicated by) Ming Î, hunting in the south, and taking the great chief (of the darkness). He should not be eager to make (all) correct (at once).

sections.Place on the wheel: 25°26'15" Pisces to 26°22'30" Pisces. Line 4 of gate 36, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject (just) entered into the left side of the belly (of the dark land). (But) he is able to carry out the mind appropriate (in the condition indicated by) Ming Î, quitting the gate and courtyard (of the lord of darkness).

sections.Place on the wheel: 26°22'30" Pisces to 27°18'45" Pisces. Line 5 of gate 36, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows how the count of Kî fulfilled the condition indicated by Ming Î. It will be advantageous to be firm and correct.

sections.Place on the wheel: 27°18'45" Pisces to 28°15' Pisces. Line 6 of gate 36, in the Solar Plexus centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth SIX, divided, shows the case where there is no light, but (only) obscurity. (Its subject) had at first ascended to (the top of) the sky; his future shall be to go into the earth.

sections.Place on the wheel: 28°15' Pisces to 29°11'15" Pisces. Line 1 of gate 25, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject free from all insincerity. His advance will be accompanied with good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 29°11'15" Pisces to 0°07'30" Aries. Line 2 of gate 25, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows one who reaps without having ploughed (that he might reap), and gathers the produce of his third year's fields without having cultivated them the first year for that end. To such a one there will be advantage in whatever direction he may move.

sections.Place on the wheel: 0°07'30" Aries to 1°03'45" Aries. Line 3 of gate 25, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows calamity happening to one who is free from insincerity;—as in the case of an ox that has been tied up. A passer by finds it (and carries it off), while the people in the neighbourhood have the calamity (of being accused and apprehended).

sections.Place on the wheel: 1°03'45" Aries to 2°00' Aries. Line 4 of gate 25, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows (a case) in which, if its subject can remain firm and correct, there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°00' Aries to 2°56'15" Aries. Line 5 of gate 25, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows one who is free from insincerity, and yet has fallen ill. Let him not use medicine, and he will have occasion for joy (in his recovery).

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°56'15" Aries to 3°52'30" Aries. Line 6 of gate 25, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows its subject free from insincerity, yet sure to fall into error, if he take action. (His action) will not be advantageous in any way.

sections.Place on the wheel: 3°52'30" Aries to 4°48'45" Aries. Line 1 of gate 17, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows us one changing the object of his pursuit; but if he be firm and correct, there will (be) good fortune. Going beyond (his own) gate to find associates, he will achieve merit.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows us one who cleaves to the little boy, and lets go the man of age and experience.

sections.Place on the wheel: 7°37'30" Aries to 8°33'45" Aries. Line 5 of gate 17, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows us (the ruler) sincere in (fostering all) that is excellent. There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 9°30' Aries to 10°26'15" Aries. Line 1 of gate 21, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows one with his feet in the stocks and deprived of his toes. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 10°26'15" Aries to 11°22'30" Aries. Line 2 of gate 21, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows one biting through the soft flesh, and (going on to) bite off the nose. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 11°22'30" Aries to 12°18'45" Aries. Line 3 of gate 21, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows one gnawing dried flesh, and meeting with what is disagreeable. There will be occasion for some small regret, but no (great) error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 12°18'45" Aries to 13°15' Aries. Line 4 of gate 21, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows one gnawing the flesh dried on the bone, and getting the pledges of money and arrows. It will be advantageous to him to realise the difficulty of his task and be firm,—in which case there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 13°15' Aries to 14°11'15" Aries. Line 5 of gate 21, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows one gnawing at dried flesh, and finding the yellow gold. Let him be firm and correct, realising the peril (of his position). There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 14°11'15" Aries to 15°07'30" Aries. Line 6 of gate 21, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth NINE, undivided, shows one wearing the cangue, and deprived of his ears. There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 15°07'30" Aries to 16°03'45" Aries. Line 1 of gate 51, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject, when the movement approaches, looking out and around with apprehension, and afterwards smiling and talking cheerfully. There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 16°03'45" Aries to 17°00' Aries. Line 2 of gate 51, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows its subject, when the movement approaches, in a position of peril. He judges it better to let go the articles (in his possession), and to ascend a very lofty height. There is no occasion for him to pursue after (the things he has let go); in seven days he will find them.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°00' Aries to 17°56'15" Aries. Line 3 of gate 51, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows its subject distraught amid the startling movements going on. If those movements excite him to (right) action, there will be no mistake.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°56'15" Aries to 18°52'30" Aries. Line 4 of gate 51, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows its subject, amid the startling movements, supinely sinking (deeper) in the mud.

sections.Place on the wheel: 18°52'30" Aries to 19°48'45" Aries. Line 5 of gate 51, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows its subject going and coming amidst the startling movements (of the time), and always in peril; but perhaps he will not incur loss, and find business (which he can accomplish).

sections.Place on the wheel: 19°48'45" Aries to 20°45' Aries. Line 6 of gate 51, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows its subject, amidst the startling movements (of the time), in breathless dismay and looking round him with trembling apprehension. If he take action, there will be evil. If, while the startling movements have not reached his own person and his neighbourhood, (he were to take precautions), there would be no error, though his relatives might (still) speak against him.

sections.Place on the wheel: 20°45' Aries to 21°41'15" Aries. Line 1 of gate 42, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows that it will be advantageous for its subject in his position to make a great movement. If it be greatly fortunate, no blame will be imputed to him.

sections.Place on the wheel: 21°41'15" Aries to 22°37'30" Aries. Line 2 of gate 42, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows parties adding to the stores of its subject ten pairs of tortoise shells whose oracles cannot be opposed. Let him persevere in being firm and correct, and there will be good fortune. Let the king, (having the virtues thus distinguished), employ them in presenting his offerings to God, and there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 22°37'30" Aries to 23°33'45" Aries. Line 3 of gate 42, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows increase given to its subject by means of what is evil, so that he shall (be led to good), and be without blame. Let him be sincere and pursue the path of the Mean, (so shall he secure the recognition of the ruler, like) an officer who announces himself to his prince by the symbol of his rank.

sections.Place on the wheel: 23°33'45" Aries to 24°30' Aries. Line 4 of gate 42, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject pursuing the due course. His advice to his prince is followed. He can with advantage be relied on in such a movement as that of removing the capital.

sections.Place on the wheel: 24°30' Aries to 25°26'15" Aries. Line 5 of gate 42, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows its subject with sincere heart seeking to benefit (all below). There need be no question about it; the result will be great good fortune. (All below) will with sincere heart acknowledge his goodness.

sections.Place on the wheel: 25°26'15" Aries to 26°22'30" Aries. Line 6 of gate 42, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the sixth NINE, undivided, we see one to whose increase none will contribute, while many will seek to assail him. He observes no regular rule in the ordering of his heart. There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 26°22'30" Aries to 27°18'45" Aries. Line 1 of gate 3, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows the difficulty (its subject has) in advancing. It will be advantageous for him to abide correct and firm; advantageous (also) to be made a feudal ruler.

sections.Place on the wheel: 27°18'45" Aries to 28°15' Aries. Line 2 of gate 3, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows (its subject) distressed and obliged to return; (even) the horses of her chariot (also) seem to be retreating. (But) not by a spoiler (is she assailed), but by one who seeks her to be his wife. The young lady maintains her firm correctness, and declines a union. After ten years she will be united, and have children.

sections.Place on the wheel: 28°15' Aries to 29°11'15" Aries. Line 3 of gate 3, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows one following the deer without (the guidance of) the forester, and only finding himself in the midst of the forest. The superior man, acquainted with the secret risks, thinks it better to give up the chase. If he went forward, he would regret it.

sections.Place on the wheel: 29°11'15" Aries to 0°07'30" Taurus. Line 4 of gate 3, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows (its subject as a lady), the horses of whose chariot appear in retreat. She seeks, however, (the help of) him who seeks her to be his wife. Advance will be fortunate; all will turn out advantageously.

sections.Place on the wheel: 0°07'30" Taurus to 1°03'45" Taurus. Line 5 of gate 3, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows the difficulties in the way of (its subject's) dispensing the rich favours that might be expected from him. With firmness and correctness there will be good fortune in small things; (even) with them in great things there will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 1°03'45" Taurus to 2°00' Taurus. Line 6 of gate 3, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows (its subject) with the horses of his chariot obliged to retreat, and weeping tears of blood in streams.

nodes.name: 27.1 · The Corners of the Mouth (Providing Nourishment), line 1

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°00' Taurus to 2°56'15" Taurus. Line 1 of gate 27, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, (seems to be thus addressed), 'You leave your efficacious tortoise, and look at me till your lower jaw hangs down.' There will be evil.

nodes.name: 27.2 · The Corners of the Mouth (Providing Nourishment), line 2

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°56'15" Taurus to 3°52'30" Taurus. Line 2 of gate 27, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows one looking downwards for nourishment, which is contrary to what is proper; or seeking it from the height (above), advance towards which will lead to evil.

nodes.name: 27.3 · The Corners of the Mouth (Providing Nourishment), line 3

sections.Place on the wheel: 3°52'30" Taurus to 4°48'45" Taurus. Line 3 of gate 27, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows one acting contrary to the method of nourishing. However firm he may be, there will be evil. For ten years let him not take any action, (for) it will not be in any way advantageous.

nodes.name: 27.4 · The Corners of the Mouth (Providing Nourishment), line 4

sections.Place on the wheel: 4°48'45" Taurus to 5°45' Taurus. Line 4 of gate 27, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows one looking downwards for (the power to) nourish. There will be good fortune. Looking with a tiger's downward unwavering glare, and with his desire that impels him to spring after spring, he will fall into no error.

nodes.name: 27.5 · The Corners of the Mouth (Providing Nourishment), line 5

sections.Place on the wheel: 5°45' Taurus to 6°41'15" Taurus. Line 5 of gate 27, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows one acting contrary to what is regular and proper; but if he abide in firmness, there will be good fortune. He should not, (however, try to) cross the great stream.

nodes.name: 27.6 · The Corners of the Mouth (Providing Nourishment), line 6

sections.Place on the wheel: 6°41'15" Taurus to 7°37'30" Taurus. Line 6 of gate 27, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth NINE, undivided, shows him from whom comes the nourishing. His position is perilous, but there will be good fortune. It will be advantageous to cross the great stream.

sections.Place on the wheel: 7°37'30" Taurus to 8°33'45" Taurus. Line 1 of gate 24, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject returning (from an error) of no great extent, which would not proceed to anything requiring repentance. There will be great good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 8°33'45" Taurus to 9°30' Taurus. Line 2 of gate 24, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows the admirable return (of its subject). There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 9°30' Taurus to 10°26'15" Taurus. Line 3 of gate 24, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows one who has made repeated returns. The position is perilous, but there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 10°26'15" Taurus to 11°22'30" Taurus. Line 4 of gate 24, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject moving right in the centre (among those represented by the other divided lines), and yet returning alone (to his proper path).

sections.Place on the wheel: 11°22'30" Taurus to 12°18'45" Taurus. Line 5 of gate 24, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows the noble return of its subject. There will be no ground for repentance.

sections.Place on the wheel: 12°18'45" Taurus to 13°15' Taurus. Line 6 of gate 24, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows its subject all astray on the subject of returning. There will be evil. There will be calamities and errors. If with his views he put the hosts in motion, the end will be a great defeat, whose issues will extend to the ruler of the state. Even in ten years he will not be able to repair the disaster.

sections.Place on the wheel: 13°15' Taurus to 14°11'15" Taurus. Line 1 of gate 2, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the first SIX, divided, (we see its subject) treading on hoarfrost. The strong ice will come (by and by).

sections.Place on the wheel: 14°11'15" Taurus to 15°07'30" Taurus. Line 2 of gate 2, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, (shows the attribute of) being straight, square, and great. (Its operation), without repeated efforts, will be in every respect advantageous.

sections.Place on the wheel: 15°07'30" Taurus to 16°03'45" Taurus. Line 3 of gate 2, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, (shows its subject) keeping his excellence under restraint, but firmly maintaining it. If he should have occasion to engage in the king's service, though he will not claim the success (for himself), he will bring affairs to a good issue.

sections.Place on the wheel: 16°03'45" Taurus to 17°00' Taurus. Line 4 of gate 2, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, (shows the symbol of) a sack tied up. There will be no ground for blame or for praise.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°00' Taurus to 17°56'15" Taurus. Line 5 of gate 2, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, (shows) the yellow lower garment. There will be great good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°56'15" Taurus to 18°52'30" Taurus. Line 6 of gate 2, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth SIX, divided (shows) dragons fighting in the wild. Their blood is purple and yellow.
sections.The extra statement of this hexagram (Le: This is not a line. Hexagrams 1 and 2 carry one more statement, for when every line changes: (The lines of this hexagram are all weak and divided, as appears from) the use of the number six. If those (who are thus represented) be perpetually correct and firm, advantage will arise.

sections.Place on the wheel: 18°52'30" Taurus to 19°48'45" Taurus. Line 1 of gate 23, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first SIX, divided, shows one overturning the couch by injuring its legs. (The injury will go on to) the destruction of (all) firm correctness, and there will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 19°48'45" Taurus to 20°45' Taurus. Line 2 of gate 23, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows one overthrowing the couch by injuring its frame. (The injury will go on to) the destruction of (all) firm correctness, and there will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 20°45' Taurus to 21°41'15" Taurus. Line 3 of gate 23, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows its subject among the overthrowers; but there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 21°41'15" Taurus to 22°37'30" Taurus. Line 4 of gate 23, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject having overthrown the couch, and (going to injure) the skin (of him who lies on it). There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 22°37'30" Taurus to 23°33'45" Taurus. Line 5 of gate 23, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows (its subject leading on the others like) a string of fishes, and (obtaining for them) the favour that lights on the inmates of the palace. There will be advantage in every way.

sections.Place on the wheel: 23°33'45" Taurus to 24°30' Taurus. Line 6 of gate 23, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows its subject (as) a great fruit which has not been eaten. The superior man finds (the people again) as a chariot carrying him. The small men (by their course) overthrow their own dwellings.

sections.Place on the wheel: 24°30' Taurus to 25°26'15" Taurus. Line 1 of gate 8, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first SIX, divided, shows its subject seeking by his sincerity to win the attachment of his object. There will be no error. Let (the breast) be full of sincerity as an earthenware vessel is of its contents, and it will in the end bring other advantages.

sections.Place on the wheel: 25°26'15" Taurus to 26°22'30" Taurus. Line 2 of gate 8, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the second SIX, divided, we see the movement towards union and attachment proceeding from the inward (mind). With firm correctness there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 26°22'30" Taurus to 27°18'45" Taurus. Line 3 of gate 8, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the third SIX, divided, we see its subject seeking for union with such as ought not to be associated with.

sections.Place on the wheel: 27°18'45" Taurus to 28°15' Taurus. Line 4 of gate 8, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the fourth SIX, divided, we see its subject seeking for union with the one beyond himself. With firm correctness there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 28°15' Taurus to 29°11'15" Taurus. Line 5 of gate 8, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, affords the most illustrious instance of seeking union and attachment. (We seem to see in it) the king urging his pursuit of the game (only) in three directions, and allowing the escape of all the animals before him, while the people of his towns do not warn one another (to prevent it). There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 29°11'15" Taurus to 0°07'30" Gemini. Line 6 of gate 8, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the topmost SIX, divided, we see one seeking union and attachment without having taken the first step (to such an end). There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 0°07'30" Gemini to 1°03'45" Gemini. Line 1 of gate 20, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first SIX, divided, shows the looking of a lad;—not blamable in men of inferior rank, but matter for regret in superior men.

sections.Place on the wheel: 1°03'45" Gemini to 2°00' Gemini. Line 2 of gate 20, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows one peeping out from a door. It would be advantageous if it were (merely) the firm correctness of a female.

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°00' Gemini to 2°56'15" Gemini. Line 3 of gate 20, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows one looking at (the course of) his own life, to advance or recede (accordingly).

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°56'15" Gemini to 3°52'30" Gemini. Line 4 of gate 20, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows one contemplating the glory of the kingdom. It will be advantageous for him, being such as he is, (to seek) to be a guest of the king.

sections.Place on the wheel: 3°52'30" Gemini to 4°48'45" Gemini. Line 5 of gate 20, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows its subject contemplating his own life(-course). A superior man, he will (thus) fall into no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 4°48'45" Gemini to 5°45' Gemini. Line 6 of gate 20, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth NINE, undivided, shows its subject contemplating his character to see if it be indeed that of a superior man. He will not fall into error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 5°45' Gemini to 6°41'15" Gemini. Line 1 of gate 16, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first SIX, divided, shows its subject proclaiming his pleasure and satisfaction. There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 6°41'15" Gemini to 7°37'30" Gemini. Line 2 of gate 16, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows one who is firm as a rock. (He sees a thing) without waiting till it has come to pass; with his firm correctness there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 7°37'30" Gemini to 8°33'45" Gemini. Line 3 of gate 16, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows one looking up (for favours), while he indulges the feeling of pleasure and satisfaction. If he would understand!—If he be late in doing so, there will indeed be occasion for repentance.

sections.Place on the wheel: 8°33'45" Gemini to 9°30' Gemini. Line 4 of gate 16, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows him from whom the harmony and satisfaction come. Great is the success which he obtains. Let him not allow suspicions to enter his mind, and thus friends will gather around him.

sections.Place on the wheel: 9°30' Gemini to 10°26'15" Gemini. Line 5 of gate 16, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows one with a chronic complaint, but who lives on without dying.

sections.Place on the wheel: 10°26'15" Gemini to 11°22'30" Gemini. Line 6 of gate 16, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows its subject with darkened mind devoted to the pleasure and satisfaction (of the time); but if he change his course even when (it may be considered as) completed, there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 11°22'30" Gemini to 12°18'45" Gemini. Line 1 of gate 35, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first SIX, divided, shows one wishing to advance, and (at the same time) kept back. Let him be firm and correct, and there will be good fortune. If trust be not reposed in him, let him maintain a large and generous mind, and there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 12°18'45" Gemini to 13°15' Gemini. Line 2 of gate 35, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows its subject with the appearance of advancing, and yet of being sorrowful. If he be firm and correct, there will be good fortune. He will receive this great blessing from his grandmother.

sections.Place on the wheel: 13°15' Gemini to 14°11'15" Gemini. Line 3 of gate 35, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows its subject trusted by all (around him). All occasion for repentance will disappear.

sections.Place on the wheel: 14°11'15" Gemini to 15°07'30" Gemini. Line 4 of gate 35, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows its subject with the appearance of advancing, but like a marmot. However firm and correct he may be, the position is one of peril.

sections.Place on the wheel: 15°07'30" Gemini to 16°03'45" Gemini. Line 5 of gate 35, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows how all occasion for repentance disappears (from its subject). (But) let him not concern himself about whether he shall fail or succeed. To advance will be fortunate, and in every way advantageous.

sections.Place on the wheel: 16°03'45" Gemini to 17°00' Gemini. Line 6 of gate 35, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows one advancing his horns. But he only uses them to punish the (rebellious people of his own) city. The position is perilous, but there will be good fortune. (Yet) however firm and correct he may be, there will be occasion for regret.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°00' Gemini to 17°56'15" Gemini. Line 1 of gate 45, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first SIX, divided, shows its subject with a sincere desire (for union), but unable to carry it out, so that disorder is brought into the sphere of his union. If he cry out (for help to his proper correlate), all at once (his tears) will give place to smiles. He need not mind (the temporary difficulty); as he goes forward, there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°56'15" Gemini to 18°52'30" Gemini. Line 2 of gate 45, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second SIX, divided, shows its subject led forward (by his correlate). There will be good fortune, and freedom from error. There is entire sincerity, and in that case (even the small offerings of) the vernal sacrifice are acceptable.

sections.Place on the wheel: 18°52'30" Gemini to 19°48'45" Gemini. Line 3 of gate 45, in the Throat centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows its subject striving after union and seeming to sigh, yet nowhere finding any advantage. If he go forward, he will not err, though there may be some small cause for regret.

sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows its subject full of apprehension and appealing (for sympathy and help). Late at night hostile measures may be (taken against him), but he need not be anxious about them.

sections.Place on the wheel: 20°45' Scorpio to 21°41'15" Scorpio. Line 3 of gate 43, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows its subject (about to advance) with strong (and determined) looks. There will be evil. (But) the superior man, bent on cutting off (the criminal), will walk alone and encounter the rain, (till he be hated by his proper associates) as if he were contaminated (by the others). (In the end) there will be no blame against him.

sections.Place on the wheel: 21°41'15" Scorpio to 22°37'30" Scorpio. Line 4 of gate 43, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows one from whose buttocks the skin has been stripped, and who walks slowly and with difficulty. (If he could act) like a sheep led (after its companions), occasion for repentance would disappear. But though he hear these words, he will not believe them.

sections.Place on the wheel: 22°37'30" Scorpio to 23°33'45" Scorpio. Line 5 of gate 43, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows (the small men like) a bed of purslain, which ought to be uprooted with the utmost determination. (The subject of the line having such determination), his action, in harmony with his central position, will lead to no error or blame.

sections.Place on the wheel: 23°33'45" Scorpio to 24°30' Scorpio. Line 6 of gate 43, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth SIX, divided, shows its subject without any (helpers) on whom to call. His end will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 24°30' Scorpio to 25°26'15" Scorpio. Line 1 of gate 14, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the first NINE, undivided, there is no approach to what is injurious, and there is no error. Let there be a realisation of the difficulty (and danger of the position), and there will be no error (to the end).

sections.Place on the wheel: 25°26'15" Scorpio to 26°22'30" Scorpio. Line 2 of gate 14, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the second NINE, undivided, we have a large waggon with its load. In whatever direction advance is made, there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 26°22'30" Scorpio to 27°18'45" Scorpio. Line 3 of gate 14, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows us a feudal prince presenting his offerings to the Son of Heaven. A small man would be unequal (to such a duty).

sections.Place on the wheel: 27°18'45" Scorpio to 28°15' Scorpio. Line 4 of gate 14, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows its subject keeping his great resources under restraint. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 28°15' Scorpio to 29°11'15" Scorpio. Line 5 of gate 14, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows the sincerity of its subject reciprocated by that of all the others (represented in the hexagram). Let him display a proper majesty, and there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 29°11'15" Scorpio to 0°07'30" Sagittarius. Line 6 of gate 14, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows its subject with help accorded to him from Heaven. There will be good fortune, advantage in every respect.

nodes.name: 34.1 · The Power of the Great, line 1

sections.Place on the wheel: 0°07'30" Sagittarius to 1°03'45" Sagittarius. Line 1 of gate 34, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject manifesting his strength in his toes. But advance will lead to evil,—most certainly.

nodes.name: 34.2 · The Power of the Great, line 2

sections.Place on the wheel: 1°03'45" Sagittarius to 2°00' Sagittarius. Line 2 of gate 34, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows that with firm correctness there will be good fortune.

nodes.name: 34.3 · The Power of the Great, line 3

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°00' Sagittarius to 2°56'15" Sagittarius. Line 3 of gate 34, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows, in the case of a small man, one using all his strength; and in the case of a superior man, one whose rule is not to do so. Even with firm correctness the position would be perilous. (The exercise of strength in it might be compared to the case of) a ram butting against a fence, and getting his horns entangled.

nodes.name: 34.4 · The Power of the Great, line 4

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°56'15" Sagittarius to 3°52'30" Sagittarius. Line 4 of gate 34, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows (a case in which) firm correctness leads to good fortune, and occasion for repentance disappears. (We see) the fence opened without the horns being entangled. The strength is like that in the wheel‐spokes of a large waggon.

nodes.name: 34.5 · The Power of the Great, line 5

sections.Place on the wheel: 3°52'30" Sagittarius to 4°48'45" Sagittarius. Line 5 of gate 34, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows one who loses his ram(‐like strength) in the ease of his position. (But) there will be no occasion for repentance.

nodes.name: 34.6 · The Power of the Great, line 6

sections.Place on the wheel: 4°48'45" Sagittarius to 5°45' Sagittarius. Line 6 of gate 34, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth SIX, divided, shows (one who may be compared to) the ram butting against the fence, and unable either to retreat, or to advance as he would fain do. There will not be advantage in any respect; but if he realise the difficulty (of his position), there will be good fortune.

nodes.name: 9.1 · The Taming Power of the Small, line 1

sections.Place on the wheel: 5°45' Sagittarius to 6°41'15" Sagittarius. Line 1 of gate 9, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject returning and pursuing his own course. What mistake should he fall into? There will be good fortune.

nodes.name: 9.2 · The Taming Power of the Small, line 2

sections.Place on the wheel: 6°41'15" Sagittarius to 7°37'30" Sagittarius. Line 2 of gate 9, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows its subject, by the attraction (of the former line), returning (to the proper course). There will be good fortune.

nodes.name: 9.3 · The Taming Power of the Small, line 3

sections.Place on the wheel: 7°37'30" Sagittarius to 8°33'45" Sagittarius. Line 3 of gate 9, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, suggests the idea of a carriage, the strap beneath which has been removed, or of a husband and wife looking on each other with averted eyes.

nodes.name: 9.4 · The Taming Power of the Small, line 4

sections.Place on the wheel: 8°33'45" Sagittarius to 9°30' Sagittarius. Line 4 of gate 9, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject possessed of sincerity. The danger of bloodshed is thereby averted, and his (ground for) apprehension dismissed. There will be no mistake.

nodes.name: 9.5 · The Taming Power of the Small, line 5

sections.Place on the wheel: 9°30' Sagittarius to 10°26'15" Sagittarius. Line 5 of gate 9, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows its subject possessed of sincerity, and drawing others to unite with him. Rich in resources, he employs his neighbours (in the same cause with himself).

nodes.name: 9.6 · The Taming Power of the Small, line 6

sections.Place on the wheel: 10°26'15" Sagittarius to 11°22'30" Sagittarius. Line 6 of gate 9, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows how the rain has fallen, and the (onward progress) is stayed;—(so) must we value the full accumulation of the virtue (represented by the upper trigram). But a wife (exercising restraint), however firm and correct she may be, is in a position of peril, (and like) the moon approaching to the full. If the superior man prosecute his measures (in such circumstances), there will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 11°22'30" Sagittarius to 12°18'45" Sagittarius. Line 1 of gate 5, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject waiting in the distant border. It will be well for him constantly to maintain (the purpose thus shown), in which case there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 12°18'45" Sagittarius to 13°15' Sagittarius. Line 2 of gate 5, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows its subject waiting on the sand (of the mountain stream). He will (suffer) the small (injury of) being spoken (against), but in the end there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 13°15' Sagittarius to 14°11'15" Sagittarius. Line 3 of gate 5, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows its subject in the mud (close by the stream). He thereby invites the approach of injury.

sections.Place on the wheel: 14°11'15" Sagittarius to 15°07'30" Sagittarius. Line 4 of gate 5, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject waiting in (the place of) blood. But he will get out of the cavern.

sections.Place on the wheel: 15°07'30" Sagittarius to 16°03'45" Sagittarius. Line 5 of gate 5, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows its subject waiting amidst the appliances of a feast. Through his firmness and correctness there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 16°03'45" Sagittarius to 17°00' Sagittarius. Line 6 of gate 5, in the Sacral centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows its subject entered into the cavern. (But) there are three guests coming, without being urged, (to his help). If he receive them respectfully, there will be good fortune in the end.

nodes.name: 26.1 · The Taming Power of the Great, line 1

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°00' Sagittarius to 17°56'15" Sagittarius. Line 1 of gate 26, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject in a position of peril. It will be advantageous for him to stop his advance.

nodes.name: 26.2 · The Taming Power of the Great, line 2

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°56'15" Sagittarius to 18°52'30" Sagittarius. Line 2 of gate 26, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows a carriage with the strap under it removed.

nodes.name: 26.3 · The Taming Power of the Great, line 3

sections.Place on the wheel: 18°52'30" Sagittarius to 19°48'45" Sagittarius. Line 3 of gate 26, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows its subject urging his way with good horses. It will be advantageous for him to realise the difficulty (of his course), and to be firm and correct, exercising himself daily in his charioteering and methods of defence; then there will be advantage in whatever direction he may advance.

nodes.name: 26.4 · The Taming Power of the Great, line 4

sections.Place on the wheel: 19°48'45" Sagittarius to 20°45' Sagittarius. Line 4 of gate 26, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows the young bull, (and yet) having the piece of wood over his horns. There will be great good fortune.

nodes.name: 26.5 · The Taming Power of the Great, line 5

sections.Place on the wheel: 20°45' Sagittarius to 21°41'15" Sagittarius. Line 5 of gate 26, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows the teeth of a castrated hog. There will be good fortune.

nodes.name: 26.6 · The Taming Power of the Great, line 6

sections.Place on the wheel: 21°41'15" Sagittarius to 22°37'30" Sagittarius. Line 6 of gate 26, in the Heart centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth NINE, undivided, shows its subject (as) in command of the firmament of heaven. There will be progress.

sections.Place on the wheel: 22°37'30" Sagittarius to 23°33'45" Sagittarius. Line 1 of gate 11, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, suggests the idea of grass pulled up, and bringing with it other stalks with whose roots it is connected. Advance (on the part of its subject) will be fortunate.

sections.Place on the wheel: 23°33'45" Sagittarius to 24°30' Sagittarius. Line 2 of gate 11, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows one who can bear with the uncultivated, will cross the Ho without a boat, does not forget the distant, and has no (selfish) friendships. Thus does he prove himself acting in accordance with the course of the due Mean.

sections.Place on the wheel: 24°30' Sagittarius to 25°26'15" Sagittarius. Line 3 of gate 11, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third NINE, undivided, shows that, while there is no state of peace that is not liable to be disturbed, and no departure (of evil men) so that they shall not return, yet when one is firm and correct, as he realises the distresses that may arise, he will commit no error. There is no occasion for sadness at the certainty (of such recurring changes); and in this mood the happiness (of the present) may be (long) enjoyed.

sections.Place on the wheel: 25°26'15" Sagittarius to 26°22'30" Sagittarius. Line 4 of gate 11, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject fluttering (down);—not relying on his own rich resources, but calling in his neighbours. (They all come) not as having received warning, but in the sincerity (of their hearts).

sections.Place on the wheel: 26°22'30" Sagittarius to 27°18'45" Sagittarius. Line 5 of gate 11, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, reminds us of (king) Tî-yî's (rule about the) marriage of his younger sister. By such a course there is happiness and there will be great good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 27°18'45" Sagittarius to 28°15' Sagittarius. Line 6 of gate 11, in the Ajna centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth six, divided, shows us the city wall returned into the moat. It is not the time to use the army. (The subject of the line) may, indeed, announce his orders to the people of his own city; but however correct and firm he may be, he will have cause for regret.

sections.Place on the wheel: 28°15' Sagittarius to 29°11'15" Sagittarius. Line 1 of gate 10, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject treading his accustomed path. If he go forward, there will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 29°11'15" Sagittarius to 0°07'30" Capricorn. Line 2 of gate 10, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows its subject treading the path that is level and easy;—a quiet and solitary man, to whom, if he be firm and correct, there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 0°07'30" Capricorn to 1°03'45" Capricorn. Line 3 of gate 10, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows a one-eyed man (who thinks he) can see; a lame man (who thinks he) can walk well; one who treads on the tail of a tiger and is bitten. (All this indicates) ill fortune. We have a (mere) bravo acting the part of a great ruler.

sections.Place on the wheel: 1°03'45" Capricorn to 2°00' Capricorn. Line 4 of gate 10, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows its subject treading on the tail of a tiger. He becomes full of apprehensive caution, and in the end there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°00' Capricorn to 2°56'15" Capricorn. Line 5 of gate 10, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows the resolute tread of its subject. Though he be firm and correct, there will be peril.

sections.Place on the wheel: 2°56'15" Capricorn to 3°52'30" Capricorn. Line 6 of gate 10, in the G centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth NINE, undivided, tells us to look at (the whole course) that is trodden, and examine the presage which that gives. If it be complete and without failure, there will be great good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 3°52'30" Capricorn to 4°48'45" Capricorn. Line 1 of gate 58, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows the pleasure of (inward) harmony. There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 4°48'45" Capricorn to 5°45' Capricorn. Line 2 of gate 58, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows the pleasure arising from (inward) sincerity. There will be good fortune. Occasion for repentance will disappear.

sections.Place on the wheel: 5°45' Capricorn to 6°41'15" Capricorn. Line 3 of gate 58, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows its subject bringing round himself whatever can give pleasure. There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 6°41'15" Capricorn to 7°37'30" Capricorn. Line 4 of gate 58, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows its subject deliberating about what to seek his pleasure in, and not at rest. He borders on what would be injurious, but there will be cause for joy.

sections.Place on the wheel: 7°37'30" Capricorn to 8°33'45" Capricorn. Line 5 of gate 58, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows its subject trusting in one who would injure him. The situation is perilous.

sections.Place on the wheel: 8°33'45" Capricorn to 9°30' Capricorn. Line 6 of gate 58, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows the pleasure of its subject in leading and attracting others.

sections.Place on the wheel: 9°30' Capricorn to 10°26'15" Capricorn. Line 1 of gate 38, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows that (to its subject) occasion for repentance will disappear. He has lost his horses, but let him not seek for them;—they will return of themselves. Should he meet with bad men, he will not err (in communicating with them).

sections.Place on the wheel: 10°26'15" Capricorn to 11°22'30" Capricorn. Line 2 of gate 38, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows its subject happening to meet with his lord in a bye‐passage. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 11°22'30" Capricorn to 12°18'45" Capricorn. Line 3 of gate 38, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): In the third SIX, divided, we see one whose carriage is dragged back, while the oxen in it are pushed back, and he is himself subjected to the shaving of his head and the cutting off of his nose. There is no good beginning, but there will be a good end.

sections.Place on the wheel: 12°18'45" Capricorn to 13°15' Capricorn. Line 4 of gate 38, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows its subject solitary amidst the (prevailing) disunion. (But) he meets with the good man (represented by the first line), and they blend their sincere desires together. The position is one of peril, but there will be no mistake.

sections.Place on the wheel: 13°15' Capricorn to 14°11'15" Capricorn. Line 5 of gate 38, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, shows that (to its subject) occasion for repentance will disappear. With his relative (and minister he unites closely and readily) as if he were biting through a piece of skin. When he goes forward (with this help), what error can there be?

sections.Place on the wheel: 14°11'15" Capricorn to 15°07'30" Capricorn. Line 6 of gate 38, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows its subject solitary amidst the (prevailing) disunion. (In the subject of the third line, he seems to) see a pig bearing on its back a load of mud, (or fancies) there is a carriage full of ghosts. He first bends his bow against him, and afterwards unbends it, (for he discovers) that he is not an assailant to injure, but a near relative. Going forward, he shall meet with (genial) rain, and there will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 15°07'30" Capricorn to 16°03'45" Capricorn. Line 1 of gate 54, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows the younger sister married off in a position ancillary to the real wife. (It suggests the idea of) a person lame on one leg who yet manages to tramp along. Going forward will be fortunate.

sections.Place on the wheel: 16°03'45" Capricorn to 17°00' Capricorn. Line 2 of gate 54, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows her blind of one eye, and yet able to see. There will be advantage in her maintaining the firm correctness of a solitary widow.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°00' Capricorn to 17°56'15" Capricorn. Line 3 of gate 54, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows the younger sister who was to be married off in a mean position. She returns and accepts an ancillary position.

sections.Place on the wheel: 17°56'15" Capricorn to 18°52'30" Capricorn. Line 4 of gate 54, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth NINE, undivided, shows the younger sister who is to be married off protracting the time. She may be late in being married, but the time will come.

sections.Place on the wheel: 18°52'30" Capricorn to 19°48'45" Capricorn. Line 5 of gate 54, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth SIX, divided, reminds us of the marrying of the younger sister of (king) Tî-yî, when the sleeves of her the princess were not equal to those of the (still) younger sister who accompanied her in an inferior capacity. (The case suggests the thought of) the moon almost full. There will be good fortune.

sections.Place on the wheel: 19°48'45" Capricorn to 20°45' Capricorn. Line 6 of gate 54, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The sixth SIX, divided, shows the young lady bearing the basket, but without anything in it, and the gentleman slaughtering the sheep, but without blood flowing from it. There will be no advantage in any way.

sections.Place on the wheel: 20°45' Capricorn to 21°41'15" Capricorn. Line 1 of gate 61, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject resting (in himself). There will be good fortune. If he sought to any other, he would not find rest.

sections.Place on the wheel: 21°41'15" Capricorn to 22°37'30" Capricorn. Line 2 of gate 61, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows its subject (like) the crane crying out in her hidden retirement, and her young ones responding to her. (It is as if it were said), 'I have a cup of good spirits,' (and the response were), 'I will partake of it with you.'

sections.Place on the wheel: 22°37'30" Capricorn to 23°33'45" Capricorn. Line 3 of gate 61, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows its subject having met with his mate. Now he beats his drum, and now he leaves off. Now he weeps, and now he sings.

sections.Place on the wheel: 23°33'45" Capricorn to 24°30' Capricorn. Line 4 of gate 61, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject (like) the moon nearly full, and (like) a horse (in a chariot) whose fellow disappears. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 24°30' Capricorn to 25°26'15" Capricorn. Line 5 of gate 61, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows its subject perfectly sincere, and linking (others) to him in closest union. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 25°26'15" Capricorn to 26°22'30" Capricorn. Line 6 of gate 61, in the Head centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost NINE, undivided, shows its subject in chanticleer (trying to) mount to heaven. Even with firm correctness there will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 26°22'30" Capricorn to 27°18'45" Capricorn. Line 1 of gate 60, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The first NINE, undivided, shows its subject not quitting the courtyard outside his door. There will be no error.

sections.Place on the wheel: 27°18'45" Capricorn to 28°15' Capricorn. Line 2 of gate 60, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The second NINE, undivided, shows its subject not quitting the courtyard inside his gate. There will be evil.

sections.Place on the wheel: 28°15' Capricorn to 29°11'15" Capricorn. Line 3 of gate 60, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The third SIX, divided, shows its subject with no appearance of observing the (proper) regulations, in which case we shall see him lamenting. But there will be no one to blame (but himself).

sections.Place on the wheel: 29°11'15" Capricorn to 0°07'30" Aquarius. Line 4 of gate 60, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fourth SIX, divided, shows its subject quietly and naturally (attentive to all) regulations. There will be progress and success.

sections.Place on the wheel: 0°07'30" Aquarius to 1°03'45" Aquarius. Line 5 of gate 60, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The fifth NINE, undivided, shows its subject sweetly and acceptably enacting his regulations. There will be good fortune. The onward progress with them will afford ground for admiration.

sections.Place on the wheel: 1°03'45" Aquarius to 2°00' Aquarius. Line 6 of gate 60, in the Root centre (the system's own grouping).
sections.The Zhouyi line (Legge, 1882): The topmost SIX, divided, shows its subject enacting regulations severe and difficult. Even with firmness and correctness there will be evil. But though there will be cause for repentance, it will (by and by) disappear.
